reasons: Overlaps on computer vision, machine learning, robotics
subject: Interested in your computer vision work
body:
Hello Professor Wu,

My name is Vinil Polepalli and I am an undergraduate at New York University, where I am pursuing a dual degree in Computer Science at the Courant Institute and Business at Stern. I was a machine learning research intern at the Carnegie Mellon Robotics Institute, where I trained a PyTorch semantic segmentation model to 0.88 mean IoU and 0.94 F1 on 25,000 labeled aerial images and integrated it into an autonomous UAV pipeline at sub-100 ms inference.

I went through your 2021 paper on 3D shape generation and completion through point-voxel diffusion, and the part I keep coming back to is that unlike most existing models that learn to deterministically translate a latent vector to a shape, your model, Point-Voxel Diffusion (PVD), is a unified. The follow-up I would want to run is how far 3D shape generation and completion carries outside the setting you tested it in, biology in particular, which is where my own work has been.

In the past, I have worked on the following related projects:
- Sole author on cVAE-augmented deep learning for pan-cancer RNA-seq classification, about 98% test accuracy across 5 cancer types: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02743
- Hsp90 inhibitor virtual screening in the Chiosis Lab at Memorial Sloan Kettering, 4,566 candidates screened at 0.984 GNN ROC AUC and 5x enrichment: https://hsp90-dashboard.vercel.app/
- Semantic segmentation for UAV-based environmental monitoring at Carnegie Mellon Robotics Institute, 0.88 mean IoU and 0.94 F1 on 25,000 labeled aerial images

I have extensively used PyTorch, OpenCV and Python in past work, but have a lot of coding experience and am adaptable to whichever libraries your lab utilizes. Please let me know if there is a fit in your lab.

I would be happy to elaborate on my skills and where I think I can best help out.

Thank you!

--
Vinil Polepalli
New York University | Class of 2029
B.S. Computer Science (Courant) and B.S. Business (Stern)
vinil.polepalli@gmail.com
